pages.title: Set Theory
pages.text: $(thing)Set Theory$()$(br2)Everything is a set. Power sets, the continuum, and the axiom of choice.

$(thing)Insight$(): 45$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Formal Logic, Cardinality.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 4 Empty Set.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): A set S has n elements. Count its subsets by size with binomial coefficients and add them up. Then the collection of all those subsets is itself a set: count ITS subsets the same way, with the inner count used as the size.
